purpose: Isolated network acceptance for server-only BBR pacer e99e90c; production is not changed.
client_control: All runs use the same baseline test binary/client. Only the server binary changes.
hard_reliability: All reliable TCP streams complete with exact payload and no unexpected connection error
No corrupted/cross-session/duplicate UDP data is accepted
Server does not crash, deadlock, or leak test processes

congestion_benefit_required.note: No benefit means hold, not Internet improvement. All no-regression and reliability gates still apply.

measurement_validity: GOMAXPROCS=1, CPU<=0.4, memory<=512MiB and shared flock
Record server CPU separately from harness+simulator CPU and cgroup throttle
If scheduler lateness/CPU quota dominates delay, mark experiment inconclusive and investigate before deployment
Injected queue/random drops and QUIC loss decisions are separate; no conversion to Internet loss percentage
No simulated or loopback result alone demonstrates real Internet speed improvement

simulation_validity_limits_before_networ.note: Exceedance marks scenario inconclusive; does not silently weaken candidate performance gate.
